About Legend

Rooted in Thai tradition.
Made for the way life feels now.

At Legend Thai Massage, the experience begins with a simple idea: your time should feel considered. The menu brings together Traditional Thai, Swedish, Deep Tissue, Combination, Couples and Four Hands Massage, giving every guest a clear way to choose the pace and style that fits the moment.

Located near Lake Pleasant in Peoria, Legend is a warm local place to step out of the day’s momentum, share what feels comfortable and make room for yourself.

Your first visit

What actually happens.

No mystery. No upsell at the end. Here is the whole thing.

From decision
to exhale.

Arrive a few minutes early

Free parking is available directly in front of Suite 104. You can share problem areas, injuries and how much pressure you prefer before the session starts.

What to wear

Traditional Thai is done fully clothed—loose clothing works best. Swedish and Deep Tissue use oil on a table with professional draping throughout.

During the session

Speak up any time. Too firm, too light, skip an area, more time somewhere else—communication helps your massage therapist tailor the experience.

Afterward

Drink water and give yourself a little room before moving into the rest of the day. Some tenderness after firmer work can happen.

Paying and tipping

Payment is handled at the studio. Tips are welcome but never expected.
